name: Amminadab
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: On the east side toward the rising of the sun pitched the standard of the camp of Judah, with Nahshon the son of Amminadab as captain, and next to him Issachar under Nethaneel the son of Zuar and Zebulun under Eliab the son of Helon.

note.label: Numbers 2: The Order of the Camps About the Tabernacle

points: Nahshon the son of Amminadab of the tribe of Judah offered the first day. The charger is simply a plate or a platter, and the bowl and the golden spoon carried the fine flour mingled with oil and the incense.

note.label: Numbers 7: The Offering of the Princes at the Dedication of the Altar

points: Pharez begat Hezron, Hezron begat Ram, Ram begat Amminadab, Amminadab begat Nahshon, Nahshon begat Salmon, Salmon begat Boaz, Boaz begat Obed, Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Hezron begat Ram, Ram begat Amminadab, Amminadab begat Nahshon the prince of the children of Judah, and from Nahshon come Salma, Boaz, Obed and Jesse.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
